sloka: पूजितान् दधिपात्रैश्च सर्पिर्भिः सुमनोक्षतैः ।मन्त्रवेदविदो विप्रान् ददर्श स महाबलः ॥६-१०-९॥।।
transliteration: pūjitān dadhipātraiśca sarpirbhiḥ sumanokṣataiḥ ।mantravedavido viprān dadarśa sa mahābalaḥ ॥6-10-9॥।।

translations.english: Mighty Vibheeshana saw there, brahmins learned in vedas and mantras, who worshipped with yellow rice, curd, clarified butter and flowers.
